visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long black hair, wearing a white zippered vest and light-colored shorts, sits on a yellow textured sofa. Behind her is a large abstract painting with pink and grey blocks. She looks directly at the camera with an energetic expression, gesturing with her hands. (2) She holds up a silver laptop which displays a video of her in the same setting, creating a frame-within-a-frame effect. (3) She presents a pink 'Hello Kitty' themed toiletry bag to the camera, opening it to reveal multiple internal mesh pockets and a hook. (4) The scene shifts to the interior of an Olive Young retail store with bright overhead lighting and shelves packed with skincare and cosmetic products. She points towards the displays. (5) Back in her room, she shows various products: a pink powder compact, cases of oil-blotting paper, and a large yellow pack of makeup remover wipes. She uses her fingers to demonstrate the texture of the powder. (6) Close-up shots show her using the makeup remover wipe on her cheek and forehead. (7) She is shown in a dining area, pouring a green sachet of powder into a glass of water and stirring it with a blue spoon before drinking. (8) She displays more skincare items including purple toner pads and teeth whitening strips, showing the application process in a bathroom setting with a mirror. (9) She applies a white cream to the back of her hand and rubs it in to show the consistency. (10) The video concludes with her sitting on the sofa, smiling and waving at the camera, with text overlays inviting viewers to her YouTube channel.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female voice greeting the audience. The BGM is a bright, electronic-pop track with a steady kick drum at 124 BPM. A 'whoosh' SFX accompanies the initial title graphics. (2) As the narrator introduces the store haul, a 'pop' SFX is heard every time a new text label appears. Her speech is rapid and enthusiastic, with high pitch variability. (3) During the product close-ups, subtle plastic rustling sounds are audible under the dominant narration. (4) In the store scene, the acoustic environment shifts slightly to include a faint room tone, but the narration remains studio-clear. (5) A distinct 'liquid splash' and stirring sound effect are used when she mixes the drink. (6) Throughout the demonstration of pimple patches and cream, the BGM maintains a consistent upbeat energy, occasionally punctuated by 'ding' effects for emphasis on key features. (7) The video concludes with a rising musical stinger as the narrator invites viewers to her YouTube channel, ending with a soft fade.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Introduction -> Sequential Product Reviews -> Usage Demonstration -> Call to Action
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To share and review a variety of beauty, health, and cosmetic products purchased from Olive Young, specifically highlighting the Sanrio/Hello Kitty collaboration items. The video serves as both an informative product showcase and a lifestyle vlog to drive engagement to the creator's YouTube channel.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Clear identification of the 'Olive Young' brand, multiple close-ups of product logos, and detailed explanations of product benefits.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video uses high-frequency editing and bright graphics typical of social media beauty vlogs to maintain a high level of viewer engagement.
